claim: The freshness check now only recognizes GET and QUERY methods, silently dropping HEAD, so existing callers relying on conditional HEAD requests will always get req.fresh === false (and req.stale === true) even when a valid ETag/Last-Modified match would previously have returned 304.
evidence:
// GET or QUERY for weak freshness validation only
  if ('GET' !== method && 'QUERY' !== method) return false;

claim: The method check for req.fresh drops HEAD entirely while adding QUERY, so HEAD requests that previously could be validated as fresh now always return false, breaking conditional GET behavior for existing HEAD callers.

The skip condition is inverted (negated) compared to the equivalent check in the very next test, so this test runs when QUERY support should be skipped and skips when QUERY is actually supported, the opposite of the intended behavior.
